name: Gummies and jelly sweets
native_basis_label: confection as placed on the market (as-sold solid)
scope_note: Covers gummies (gelatin/pectin soft candies) and jelly sweets (fruit jellies, Turkish delight). Gummies are soft candies, so the lead and total-arsenic cells bind the candy limits (100 ug/kg); fruit-jelly-sweet limits (fruit/vegetable sweets, jams/jellies) are looser and noted in the audit. Supplement gummies with a Supplement Facts panel route to Cat 16.

Pb.basis: confection as sold (gummies are soft candies)

Cd.rationale: Gelatin/pectin/sugar gummies and fruit-jelly sweets have no cadmium source; there is no cocoa and no soil-uptake plant tissue at the confection level. Rebuttable if a routed source reports cadmium in a jelly confection.
Cd.regulatory_basis: No gummy/jelly-sweet cadmium ML in any jurisdiction

tAs.basis: confection as sold (gummies are soft candies)

iAs.rationale: No inorganic-arsenic ML for gummies/jelly sweets; the total-arsenic candy limit (100 ug/kg) bounds the inorganic fraction.
iAs.regulatory_basis: Bounded by the total-As candy standard; no inorganic-As ML anywhere

tHg.rationale: No mercury source and no bioaccumulation pathway in a sugar/gelatin/pectin confection.
tHg.reference_method: No mercury pathway; screen on any novel ingredient.
tHg.regulatory_basis: No gummy/jelly mercury ML anywhere; no pathway

MeHg.rationale: No mercury source or methylmercury pathway in a gummy/jelly sweet.
MeHg.regulatory_basis: No methylmercury ML anywhere; no pathway

Ni.rationale: Gelatin/pectin/sugar gummies and fruit jellies contain no hydrogenated fat and no nickel source; no jurisdiction sets a nickel ML for confectionery. Rebuttable if a routed source reports nickel in a jelly confection.
Ni.regulatory_basis: No gummy/jelly nickel ML anywhere; no nickel pathway

Sn.rationale: No tin source in a pouched/wrapped gummy or jelly sweet; the jams/jellies tin limit (250 mg/kg) is a tinplate-can migration limit for canned product, not applicable to non-canned confection.
Sn.reference_method: Packaging control (non-tinplate); periodic ICP-MS tin verification.
Sn.regulatory_basis: No non-canned gummy/jelly tin ML; canned-jelly 250 mg/kg limit is can-only
Sn.jurisdictions_checked: Codex CXS 193; Thailand MOPH 414; EU; FDA

Al.rationale: Aluminium in gummies derives from permitted aluminium-lake colour additives, managed by additive law and intake vs the TWI, not by a per-food contaminant ML.
Al.reference_method: Managed by additive law + TWI; periodic screen.
Al.regulatory_basis: Al managed by additive law + TWI; no gummy/jelly contaminant ML

Cr.rationale: No total-chromium food ML in any jurisdiction. Screened as the substrate for reflex Cr-VI speciation.
Cr.reference_method: Total-chromium screen; substrate for reflex Cr-VI speciation.
Cr.trigger: reflex Cr-VI speciation only if total chromium is anomalously elevated

Cr-VI.rationale: Hexavalent chromium reduces to chromium(III) in a reducing sugar/gelatin confection matrix; no Cr-VI food ML exists.
Cr-VI.reference_method: No routine Cr-VI speciation; reflex only on anomalously elevated total chromium.
Cr-VI.regulatory_basis: No Cr-VI food ML anywhere; reduces to Cr-III in matrix

method: HMTc Method v2.0 (government-limit default; explicit-id lookup; legislated product-form splits preserved)
